content_of_post_to_answer: What mindset shift helped you stop overthinking every single conversation?
answer: The shift that helped me was realizing that most conversations are not performances being judged; they are small moments of connection that both people usually forget far sooner than we imagine. Overthinking often comes from assuming others are analyzing us with the same intensity we analyze ourselves. I’ve explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. The freedom comes when you stop asking “How did I appear?” and start asking “Was I genuinely present?”
